أنحرق (form VII)
# أَنْحَرِقُ (ʔanḥariqu) /ʔan.ħa.ri.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَرَقَ (inḥaraqa)
# أَنْحَرِقَ (ʔanḥariqa) /ʔan.ħa.ri.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَرَقَ (inḥaraqa)
# أَنْحَرِقْ (ʔanḥariq) /ʔan.ħa.riq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَرَقَ (inḥaraqa)
